column1: # The teams that a room's code names: <code> TAB <ffa | A+B>. Read by test_lockstep N2.101 (net::room_code_teams, the server's and every game's reading) and by tests/scripts/web_lobby_check.js
# (codeTeams of web/lobby.html): the two readings must agree on every line. A team word is t<a><b>, two seats 0 - 3, the lower first, a word of a demo code after its first word.
# codes without a word mean what they always did
# the word may be anywhere after the first word, in any case, and may end the code
# what is no word: the higher seat first, equal seats, a seat above 3, other lengths, a word inside another, a digit that is not a seat
# the first word is the map's or the player count's, never a word of teams; the prefix is exact; only a demo code names teams
# a word in a code for two players is a word (the room says at its start that two seats cannot be teams)
